title: Partition Array to Minimize Sum Difference

monster.name: Equipartition Leviathan
monster.title: Twin Sunderer of Arrays
monster.defeatQuote: Partition 2*n items into two arrays of n elements each, minimizing difference!

description: You are given an integer array `nums` of `2 * n` integers. You need to partition `nums` into two arrays of length `n` to minimize the absolute difference of their sums. Return the minimum possible absolute difference.
starterCode:
def minimumDifference(nums: list[int], n: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def minimumDifference(nums: list[int], n: int) -> int:
    from bisect import bisect_left
    total = sum(nums)
    left, right = nums[:n], nums[n:]
    left_sums = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    right_sums = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
    for mask in range(1 << n):
        sz = bin(mask).count('1')
        l_s = sum(left[i] for i in range(n) if (mask & (1 << i)))
        r_s = sum(right[i] for i in range(n) if (mask & (1 << i)))
        left_sums[sz].append(l_s)
        right_sums[sz].append(r_s)
    for sz in range(n + 1):
        right_sums[sz].sort()
    ans = float('inf')
    for sz in range(n + 1):
        r_sz = n - sz
        r_list = right_sums[r_sz]
        for l_s in left_sums[sz]:
            target = total / 2 - l_s
            idx = bisect_left(r_list, target)
            if idx < len(r_list):
                s = l_s + r_list[idx]
                ans = min(ans, abs(total - 2 * s))
            if idx > 0:
                s = l_s + r_list[idx - 1]
                ans = min(ans, abs(total - 2 * s))
    return ans
hints: Meet-in-the-middle: group subset sums of left and right halves by their size k. For each k, binary search for the best complement in right_sums[n - k].
